title: You can't see your stale documents, and that's why they're stale
summary: A Business Central extension called Unposted Document Aging provides a single list combining sales quotes, orders, and unposted invoices organized into priority bands by age and status. Instead of manual Excel reports, it shows which documents are stale and who owns them, with automated daily email digests per salesperson.
key_points: Consolidates sales quotes, orders, and unposted invoices into one read-only view with ownership and age information
Organizes documents into six priority bands (Shipped Not Invoiced, Quote Expired, Invoice Unposted, Order Stale, Quote Stale, Other) to highlight money sitting uninvoiced
Uses configurable date thresholds (30 days for quotes, 14 for orders, 7 for invoices) based on either Document Date or Created date
Sends personalized daily email digests to each salesperson showing only their stale documents
Built entirely on temporary buffers with no stored data, using SetFilter for SQL-level performance optimization
features: Document Date vs Created date switching
